Class ColorParser

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.types.parser.ColorParser
All Implemented Interfaces:
TypeParser<Color>, Function<Object,Color>
public class ColorParser extends Object implements TypeParser<Color>
Represents a parser that try to convert any String representation of Color.
Using RGBA and HEX as primary format, but also supports type-specific formats like OKLCH.
